_note: On-screen copy for the Flippo App Store screenshot proposal. Headlines, eyebrows and captions of shots 1, 4, 5 (headline only), 6 are the approved copy from the live localized store set (assets/archive/2026-10/screenshots/6.9/<locale>/). Win-card strings and the Daily Challenge name come from the app's Localizable.strings. Everything else is new and needs native review. The 'NEW' pill stays in English in every locale, as in the live set. 'Mia' and 'Flippo' are names and are never translated.
